wild. Living free in nature, not with people.
relax. To rest and feel calm.
sky. The space above us with the sun and clouds.
appliance. A machine in the home, like a fridge.
worst. The most bad; the opposite of best.
spend. To use your time doing something.
vomit. To throw up food when you feel sick.
season. Spring, summer, fall or winter.
vacation. Time away from school or work to rest.
